about:
Senior Software Engineer with 6 years of experience building scalable web applications and AI-powered systems. I specialise in **TypeScript**, **React**, and **Node.js**, with growing depth in **Python** and **FastAPI**, and a strong focus on performance, clean architecture, and end-to-end ownership.

I've built production AI agents, designed compliance platforms used by enterprise clients globally, and contributed to scaling products from early-stage to hundreds of thousands of users. On my own time, I've built multi-agent AI systems and RAG-backed applications from scratch — including a risk analysis platform with a deterministic rule engine layered under AI narration, and a study scheduler with streaming LLM output and pgvector-backed retrieval. I care deeply about code quality, developer experience, and shipping things that actually matter.

Outside of work, I enjoy exploring new technologies, building side projects, and staying curious about what comes next in software and AI.
